scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/server && npm install && cd ../debug-client && npm install
scripts.dev:server:fresh: node scripts/dev-bootstrap.mjs && cd apps/server && AKALYNTH_BOOTSTRAP=1 CHRONICLE_KEY_PATH=chronicle.key ALLOW_INSECURE_LOCAL=1 npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:packages: npm -w @akalynth/coordination-kernel run build && npm -w @akalynth/learning-spine run build && npm -w @akalynth/verification-spine run build
scripts.build:game: (cd apps/phone-server && npm run build) && (cd apps/studio && npm run build) && (cd apps/debug-client && npm run build) && npm run studio-smoke
scripts.verify:account-character: bash scripts/verify_protocol_sync.sh && npm -w apps/server run verify:quick && npm -w apps/server run test:web-economy && npm -w apps/debug-client run verify:account-character && cd apps/android && ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest --tests 'com.akalynth.client.network.IdentityApiAccountCharacterTest' --tests 'com.akalynth.client.config.BuildConfigPortalTest'
